title: Version 1.33.0
body:
Version 1.33.0

August 2nd, 2023

Added:

  • Added brand new Tape Measure tool! (can be bought at Illumine)
  • Added new vehicle color variant
  • Added new atmosphere system in preparation for weather!

Changes:

  • The time system is no longer global
  • Daytime and nighttime durations are adjusted, times currently unknown

Bug Fixes:

  • Misc bug fixes

Version 1.33.1

August 2nd, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Temp Fix for drowning

Version 1.33.2

August 2nd, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed floating numbers corresponding to the Tape Measure UI
  • Fixed drowning above the surface of the water

Version 1.33.3
